transcript.text: I need to put something on the record that I haven't formally documented yet. I personally observed exactly three recent incidents where Mosaic participants were interrupted before they could finish speaking during joint Northstar-Mosaic forum interactions. We've been trying to resolve this tension informally between the chairs, which is why it hasn't been entered into the formal forum record. For this proposed combined forum, I believe the appropriate safeguard is specifically a neutral external facilitator. An internal rotating facilitator drawn from either ERG would not adequately address this concern, given that the pattern involves participants from one ERG being interrupted.
